adherence-logging-and-attestation.reason: This session updated the DR's status line from PROPOSED to RATIFIED and recorded what an adversarial pass found and fixed IN the mechanisms this DR specifies (severity missing from the RULE's own required finding shape; a path-traversal bypass; the findings-block reader missing this harness's actual SubagentHandback delivery shape), without editing the DR's substantive sections -- the DR's own section 8 rule (no adversarial pass may be commissioned against a Decision Record) is honoured by attacking the CONSTRUCTION the DR specifies, never the DR text itself. Touching decisions/ is a rule-2 attestation path.

deviations.reason: Phase 1a's construction (RC4) surfaced defects the DR's own section 1.2 specification did not anticipate: the RULE's own text (section quoted in project-standards.md) requires severity and a one-pass-per-batch limit that DR-2026-09-26 v2's schema and writer design omitted. This session added both directly to the migration and writer rather than treating them as a DR erratum requiring re-ratification, on the reasoning that they implement a requirement the RULE already states rather than adding a new one. That reasoning is recorded here, not independently checked.

This session performed four review passes on its own construction of phases 1a-1d (a dispatched antagonist agent, /code-review, /simplify with four parallel cleanup agents, and its own ongoing scrutiny that caught the data/guidebook.db schema-vs-data classification gap and the scratchpad/CURRENT folder-name mismatch), and adjudicated every finding itself. No pass was run by a session with no stake in the outcome existing independently of this one.

bias_direction: This session wrote the code, ran the adversarial review against its own diff, adjudicated every finding from that review, then ran further self-directed cleanup passes and adjudicated those too. Every fix credited to a review round is a fix this same continuous session then implemented and is now vouching for. There is a specific pull toward treating a large volume of caught-and-fixed findings as proof of thoroughness, when an antagonist genuinely independent of the outcome might have found different or additional defects, particularly in the parts of the diff no reviewer's prompt specifically pointed at.
independent_reviewer_counterclaim: A reviewer could reasonably object that the antagonist agent, though a separate model invocation, was dispatched, briefed, and had its findings adjudicated entirely by the authoring session -- structurally closer to a self-check with extra steps than to the fresh-session independence the 2026-08-19 RULE and DR-2026-08-19 section 7 describe as the standard. Against that: the antagonist genuinely ran read-only with no visibility into the authoring session's reasoning beyond the diff and the DR text it was pointed at, its sixteen findings included several this session had not itself noticed (the migration-application gap, the SubagentHandback delivery-path mismatch, the EXAMINED double-count, the RC3 seed anchor collision with its own new ledger entry), and every finding was checked against the artefact before being accepted or rejected rather than taken on the antagonist's word -- which is the discipline CLAUDE.md section 1 asks of any check, adversarial or otherwise.
